claim.quote: The atmospheric oscillation parameters are measured to be sin²θ23= 0.51, and Δm²31 = 2.18×10⁻³ eV². The inverted neutrino mass ordering hypothesis is disfavoured with a p-value of 0.25.

date.note: Date recorded is the arXiv preprint submission date; no journal publication record was found/fetched this session, so date_kind is 'preprint'.

key_value_text.quote: A high-purity neutrino sample was extracted, corresponding to an exposure of 433 kton-years. The sample of 5828 neutrino candidates is analysed following a binned log-likelihood method
key_value_text.value: sin²θ23 = 0.51 (+0.04/-0.05); Δm²31 = 2.18×10⁻³ eV² (+0.25/-0.35, with a degenerate branch at [-2.25,-1.76]×10⁻³ eV² at 68% CL); inverted mass ordering disfavoured, p-value 0.25. Based on 5828 neutrino candidates, 433 kton-years exposure, ORCA6 (6 of the planned 115 detection units).

name: Measurement of neutrino oscillation parameters with the first six detection units of KM3NeT/ORCA
notes: ORCA6 result added as an optional (non-mandatory) result to give KM3NeT full flagship depth, per the brief's suggestion of an ORCA oscillation result.

significance.locator: Abstract, arXiv:2408.07015 (multi-parameter fit; p-value reported instead of significance, see key_value_text)
significance.note: A multi-parameter oscillation fit, not a single-significance discovery/observation; the abstract instead reports a p-value of 0.25 disfavouring the inverted mass ordering, recorded in key_value_text.

summary.plain: Using just the first six strings of the ORCA detector, KM3NeT measured how atmospheric neutrinos change type on their way through the Earth, getting an early look at the neutrino mass-ordering puzzle without yet settling it.
summary.technical: First neutrino-oscillation analysis with the ORCA6 sub-array (6 of the planned 115 detection units), 433 kton-years exposure, 5828 neutrino candidates: sin²θ23 = 0.51(+0.04/-0.05), Δm²31 = 2.18(+0.25/-0.35)×10⁻³ eV²; inverted mass ordering disfavoured at p = 0.25.

title: Measurement of neutrino oscillation parameters with the first six detection units of KM3NeT/ORCA
why_it_matters: Demonstrates that even a small fraction of the planned ORCA array can perform competitive atmospheric-oscillation measurements, validating the detector concept ahead of full ORCA construction and its neutrino-mass-ordering goal.
